title: Finished Product Quality Specifications & Sensory Release Matrix
content: Every finished batch of Everest Premium Lager must pass mandatory analytical and sensory gate checks prior to packaging release: 1. Alcohol By Volume (ABV): 5.0% ± 0.1% measured via DMA densitometer, 2. Bitterness: 12.0 ± 1.0 IBU via spectrophotometric isooctane extraction, 3. Original Gravity: 11.20 ± 0.20 °Plato (1.045 SG), 4. Apparent Extract: 2.00 ± 0.15 °Plato (1.008 SG), 5. Carbonation (CO2): 2.65 ± 0.05 volumes (5.2 g/L), 6. Dissolved Oxygen (DO) in Bright Beer Tank: strictly < 20 ppb (spec target ≤ 12 ppb), 7. Diacetyl: < 0.030 ppm (< 30 ppb via gas chromatography). A certified 5-member sensory panel must sign off with zero off-flavors (DMS, acetaldehyde, or oxidation) before cellar gate release.

title: Non-Conformance Holds, Rework Blending & Quarantine Protocols
content: When a production batch or packaging lot breaches specification limits, the following Rework & Quarantine protocol is mandatory: 1. Immediate QA Red Hold Tagging: In ERP, the lot status is locked to 'QUARANTINE-REWORK-PENDING' and physical red lockouts applied to vessel/pallet outfeed. 2. High DO / Under-Carbonated Beer Rework: If DO is between 20-35 ppb or carbonation < 2.4 vol, product may undergo in-line deaerated water blending or secondary carbonation stone sparging in Bright Tank at -1.0°C. 3. High Diacetyl Batch Rework: Warm krausening with 5% active fermenting wort at 14°C for 48 hours to metabolize diacetyl. 4. Seamer Defect / Packaging Jam Rework: Sealed cans with seam overlap < 45% must be quarantined, mechanically decanted under sterile CO2 blanket, and routed through the sterile separator loop for beer recovery. 5. Severe Microbiological Failure (> 1 CFU/100mL wild yeast or lactic acid bacteria): Strict discard authorization signed by Master Brewer and Quality Director.

title: Packaging Line Double Seam Inspection & Optical Bottle Inspector (EBI)
content: Double seam integrity on Canning Lines 1 & 3 must undergo micrometer destructive teardown inspection every 2 hours: 1. Seam Overlap percentage must exceed 55% (minimum 45%), 2. Seam Tightness (wrinkle rating) must score 90-100%, 3. Seam Thickness and Countersink depth verified with digital optical seam projector. On Line 4 Bottling, Empty Bottle Inspector (EBI) optical and high-frequency sensors continuously reject scuffed, cracked, or foreign-body contaminated returnable bottles at 1,000 bpm with a target 99.98% detection reliability.

title: Microbiological Screening & HACCP Swab Validation
content: Daily plating on Universal Beer Agar (UBA), Hsu's Lactobacillus-Pediococcus (HLP) medium, and Lin's Wild Yeast Medium (LWYM) is executed for all fermentation, lagering, bright beer vessels, and filler valves. Critical Control Points (CCP-1: Flash Pasteurization 18 PU; CCP-2: Final Sterile Filtration 0.45µm) require zero detectable colony-forming units (0 CFU/100mL). ATP bioluminescence surface swabs on packaging line conveyor tracks must yield < 50 RLU prior to filling start.
